description: This file contains a test implementation of the IQueueAdapterReceiverMonitor interface, providing tracking for various receiver events such as initialization, read, message reception, and shutdown, along with a serializable counter class.

classes.name: EventHubReceiverMonitorForTesting
classes.description: A test implementation of IQueueAdapterReceiverMonitor that tracks method call counts.

classes.name: EventHubReceiverMonitorCounters
classes.description: A serializable class holding counters for monitor method calls.

methods.name: TrackInitialization
methods.description: Tracks initialization attempts, incrementing counter if successful.

methods.name: TrackRead
methods.description: Tracks read attempts, incrementing counter if successful.

methods.name: TrackShutdown
methods.description: Tracks shutdown attempts, incrementing counter if successful.
